reason: The parent protocol froze paired Brier and log-loss gates but did not define the scalar projection for five-state Asian settlement or deterministic bootstrap settings. This supplement fixes those mechanical definitions before any target score column is read; it does not change a model, cohort, comparator, threshold, or gate.

scoring.opposite_side: The opposite quote is retained in the prediction artifact for audit and EV diagnostics but is not a second scoring unit.
scoring.market_probability: proportional devig of the two frozen Pinnacle closing decimal prices
scoring.log_loss: -actual_cashflow_score*ln(p) - (1-actual_cashflow_score)*ln(1-p), with p clamped to [1e-12,1-1e-12] only for numerical safety

comparisons.paired_difference: candidate score minus comparator score; lower is better

bootstrap.method: fixture-level paired percentile bootstrap with replacement

decision.all_required: For each market, all four candidate-minus-comparator Brier/log-loss one-sided 95% upper bounds must be <= 0.
decision.failure: REJECTED; do not change parameters, scoring, or thresholds on this cohort and do not implement, grant, or deploy the failed candidate.
decision.success: Eligible for local minimal implementation and self-acceptance only; ledger grant and deployment still require separate Owner authorization.
